text:
marta: Quick heads-up — the nightly review form import from Lattice errored out. ~35 profiles stuck, error points at manager field mapping (manager_id not found). Anyone else seeing this?
jeff: Saw the alert. Error says `manager_id not found` for some contractors who were removed in Lattice. I can patch the CSV but want to avoid manual edits across many rows.
sana: Are these the folks with cross-team managers? We had several matrix-managed folks who got re-mapped during the org change last month.
ryan: If it's only manager_id we can run a re-import with a temporary bypass: `hr-import --file reviews.csv --skip-manager-validate` — but that means notifications may go to the wrong people until we backfill. Tradeoff.
marta: Prefer to keep notifications accurate. Can we re-run only the failed rows after we backfill `manager_email` instead of skipping validation?
jeff: Exported failed rows to `failed_reviews_1923.csv`. There are ~12 orphan manager_ids. I can join against PeopleDB to backfill `manager_email` and re-run just those rows. Doing that now.
luca: @marta quick note — re-running imports mid-cycle will bump  `last_updated` on those review objects which may confuse reviewers. Suggest we put a short calendar-edit lock during the import window.
marta: Calendar-lock sounds good. Define: freeze reviewer edits for 1 hour around the import so people don't see partial data. Who can toggle that?
sana: I can toggle the `review-edit-lock` in the HR app. Path: Settings > Reviews > Edit Lock -> toggle. I'll schedule it for 10:00am PT. Can we get a quiet deploy window from eng?
ryan: I'll ping eng-oncall to avoid deploys 09:45-10:30. Also: because this shifts things, can we move one calibration block? We had Tue 2-4p and Wed 3-5p. If import + fix takes time, managers may miss Tue.
marta: Okay — propose moving the smaller cross-functional block Tue 2-3 to Thu 11-12 to free up Tue for imports/follow-ups. Need manager sign-off though.
jeff: Pinged managers: @all-managers — proposal: move Tue 2-3 -> Thu 11-12 to accommodate import/resync. Quick yay/nay?
luca (hr-bot): Reminder queued: calibration-reschedule-notice will go out to managers in 15m. /remind posted.
sana: Backfill done. Re-running import on the 35 failed rows now with validated `manager_email`.
marta: Also can we delay the self-assessment submission deadline by 24h to give ICs a little buffer while we sort this?
ryan: Sounds fine. I'll update the public timeline doc and notify legal if the extension impacts comp schedule.
jeff: Import finished: processed 35 rows, 0 failures. Sent a test manager notification to confirm routing.
marta: Confirmed — test manager received the notification. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Closing thread :tada:
